'''Conduit Inlet Manifold''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A large inlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.|Underground pipelines with a rather convoluted history of development. This upgrade of the Conduit Inlet is furnished with a manifold of connection openings. Plumbers often call these by their nicknames: pan flute inlets.}}
==Usage==
A large inlet facility for an underground pipeline. Connect this to a matching Conduit Outlet Manifold to transport fluids through it.

==Acquisition==
Requirement : [[AIC Factory Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC III - Conduit Manifolds]]
